own-setid.title: SIMVASTATIN TABLET, FILM COATED [MERCK SHARP & DOHME LLC]
own-setid.text: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Avoid large quantities of grapefruit juice (> 1 quart daily) with simvastatin.

own-setid-no-food.title: ISONIAZID TABLET [SANDOZ INC]
own-setid-no-food.text: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Isoniazid may increase phenytoin levels. Take on an empty stomach.
